body.statement: Under the premises of \(\text{thm:qpath-completion-exactness}\), \(\operatorname{Enum}_G(\mathcal O_G)\) emits exactly \(\Theta_G(\mathcal O_G)\), each numerical tuple once. In the ordered exact-real model \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{ER}}\), deterministic construction and pruning of \(\mathcal D_G\), exact lexicographic row interning, integer-fragment trie propagation, decoding, and output require \(O(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p\max\{1,N_{\mathrm{out}}\})\) total time and space; an explicit time bound is \(O((m+|E|)p^3 2^p+p^3 2^pN_{\mathrm{out}}+mp^2N_{\mathrm{out}})\). No hash oracle on real numbers and no traversal of all compatible orders is used.
body.justification: The theorem supplies the exact-once, output-sensitive numerical frontier that the parent calibration proposal lacked.
body.gap: GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects, Theorem 3, minimally partitions MPDAGs by distinct total-effect functionals. WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration, Theorem 1, establishes AMO enumeration; Theorem 4 gives exact-once \(O(n+m)\)-delay bucket-AMO enumeration; Corollary 1 covers MPDAGs; and Theorem 5 covers PDAG consistent extensions after \(O(n^3)\) initialization. None enumerates covariance-dependent LiMVAM coefficient tuples from a \(2^p\)-state recursive representation with cost controlled by the number of distinct numerical outputs.
body.consumer: The PairwiseLiMVAM and DirectLiMVAM workflow can report every population coefficient mechanism licensed by partial pairing before applying the inherited covariance-region inference to sampling uncertainty.
